oneOf.description: BM25 blended with a 30-day recency boost (the default).
Newest first. Filter-only queries always sort this way.

include_archived.description: Include archived channels (default true; hits are marked).

include_unjoined_public.description: Also search public channels the caller has not joined (ignored for guests).

limit.description: Page size 1–100, default 20. Pages may be shorter; follow `has_more`.

q.description: The query (1–1,000 bytes after trimming; syntax in `docs/search.md`).

tz.description: IANA time zone for date filters; default the caller's profile zone, else `UTC`.
